'''Cato'''<ref name="Wrong Jedi" /> was a dancing establishment<ref name="Catch" /> in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], near [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]' dwelling. The name was written in [[Trade Federation Basic/Legends|Trade Federation Basic]] on an [[Color|orange]] and yellow neon sign. Below that, there was an abstract yellow motif<ref name="Wrong Jedi" /> which contained additional text written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] script, reading "DANCE".<ref name="Catch">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref> The business was located on [[Level 1312/Legends|Level 1312]].<ref name="Wrong Jedi" />
